newsitem.title: USA: Medical Industries buys Fla group practice.
newsitem.headline: Medical Industries buys Fla group practice.

text.p: Medical Industries of America Inc said on Thursday that it acquired Florida Physicians Internet Inc from Dr. A. Razzak Tai.
The company agreed to give Dr. Tai $1.5 million in cash and preferred shares, payable over a three-year period.

Tai will retain supervisory control over all medical aspects of operations, while the company said it would provide administrative management, marketing and financial support for the central Florida group practice.
"With Florida Physicians Internet, we have taken the first vital step toward realizing a substantial increase in revenues and earnings," said Harry Kobrin, president of Medical Industries.
The company expects Florida Physicians Internet to generate annual revenue of $2.4 million and net income of about $1 million.
Florida Physicians Internet, on behalf of Medical Industries, is currently in negotiations with several physician groups and managed-care providers in central Florida.
